_doc: Picture/sound contract of the kit's template short (engine/remotion/src/videos/_template). Copy this folder's shape for a new video: 30 fps, shots in order with ids 1, 2, 3 ..., frames a <= f < b, a kit place and a light preset per shot, optional crossfades (shot id -> frames) and flash frames, and the action frames as events.

places.garden: Gus's back garden with the hole (kit place, town)
places.earth: the Earth cutaway in space (kit place)

shots.what: medium shot: Gus by the hole talks to the lens, points down at it on 'hole'

shots.line: It goes all the way through.
shots.what: cut to the Earth cutaway: tiny Gus falls along the tunnel, an arrow pops in beside him
back in the garden, wider: thumbs-up with a sparkle
